driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic SE050 Device and its commands, which go through the T=1 session and the optional SCP03 channel, then the CRTP I2C interface, which calls the platform port you write, which drives the I2C bus and the ENA pin of the SE050.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application talks to one se050::Device<Transport> object, whose public commands are listed from inc/se050_device.hpp. Each command builds an APDU, which the T=1 session (inc/se050_t1_session.hpp) frames into blocks with a CRC-16 EDC, chains and acknowledges; when an SCP03 session is open the APDU is wrapped first. The communication interface (se050::I2cTransceiveInterface in inc/se050_i2c_transport_interface.hpp) is a CRTP base. The platform port is the only code you write: the methods listed from that header's requirements. Below it is the SE050 on I2C.
